subject: physics
question_text: Define work, power and energy. State their SI units.

verification.note: Sri Chaitanya IPE Junior Fastrack (Rev. May 2024), Unit 6 VERY SHORT ANSWER. The 1+1 mark split is invented and needs a Telangana IPE teacher; no exam appearance years are printed for this question, so appearances[] stays empty. The TSBIE Basic Learning Material has no VSAQ section for this unit, so the Fastrack is the only source for it.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Work and power
lines: the product of the force and the

lines.text: W = F S cos θ,  SI unit: joule (J)

lines: the work done per unit time.

lines.text: P = W / t,  SI unit: watt (W)

steps.margin_note: Definition, formula and unit for each. The unit is a separate thing to lose.
steps.why: Power is the rate, not the amount. Two engines can do the same work, and the faster one is the more powerful.
common_mistakes: Giving power the unit joule. A watt is a joule PER SECOND.

recall.must_convey: That work is force times displacement in joules, and power is work per unit time in watts.
accept: work is force into displacement, joule
power is work per unit time, watt
power ante work by time, watt
reject: energy is the capacity to do work

steps.memory_tip: Work in joule; power is work PER TIME, in watt.

steps.label: Energy
lines: the capacity of a body to do work.
steps.margin_note: Energy and work share the joule — say so, it shows you know why.
steps.why: Energy is measured by how much work it could do, so it cannot have any other unit than work has.
common_mistakes: Defining energy as "power" or listing calories as the SI unit.

recall.must_convey: That energy is the capacity to do work, measured in joules.
accept: energy is the capacity to do work
reject: power is work per unit time

steps.memory_tip: Energy is the capacity to do work, so it shares the joule.

insider_note: Three definitions and three units for two marks: work and power share the first mark, so both of them must be complete to earn it.
